regeneration: Hand-authored bounded corpus; there is no generator and no runtime is consulted to author it. Revalidate deterministically with validation_command: the oracle recomputes every expected observation from context/pre_state/command under the declared reject_precedence and fails closed on any drift.

scalar_encoding.atom_fields: canonical base-10 string, unsigned, no leading zeros, 0 <= value <= 2^128-1
scalar_encoding.delta_fields: canonical base-10 string, optional single leading '-', no leading zeros, -2^127 <= value <= 2^127-1
scalar_encoding.small_integer_fields: JSON integer with exact int type; bool-as-int and integral floats are rejected

unreachable_codes.reason: Under the intended rule the sender is evaluated before any credited principal, and a valid pre-state keeps the per-asset account total at or below supply, which is itself at most 2^128-1. A credited post-balance can therefore exceed 2^128-1 only when the sender is already insufficient, so the intended outcome is never BALANCE_OVERFLOW over this corpus.

nonclaims: Bounded executable research evidence for the two named ASSET_TRANSFER transitions only; no universal Python/Rust equivalence is proved.
No production, settlement, release, migration, proof, or value-moving authority is created or implied by this corpus.
custody_domain is an accounting-location or control-domain label; no claim of asset possession or legal title by the protocol is made.

No claim is made about state roots, receipt roots, effect-plan roots, or module journal roots as exact bytes, and no cross-language byte agreement is claimed; the corpus checks only the observations listed in checked_observations, and root equality is asserted only within one runtime for rejected no-ops.
No claim is made about canonical encodings, hash-domain separation, or serialization agreement across languages.

The corpus covers single-asset states and one command per pre-state only; multi-asset states, command sequencing, concurrency, and authorization beyond the subject_id equality performed by the transitions are out of scope.
BALANCE_OVERFLOW is declared unreachable only over this corpus under the stated pre-state invariant; no universal unreachability proof is claimed.

Case precedence-insufficient-balance-over-recipient-overflow-sender-sorts-last records a confirmed pre-existing Rust defect. This branch does not repair runtime code, so the corresponding Rust refinement assertion is an expected failing counterexample until the transition is repaired.

Two further latent Python/Rust divergence regions were observed while authoring this corpus and are deliberately excluded from it: an aggregated sender delta of exactly -2^127, and a fee owner aliasing the sender when amount+fee exceeds 2^127-1. The corpus makes no claim about either region.
